findings.detail: Investment rows with source fair value rendered as a dash are being counted as missing fair_value rather than normalized to zero.

rationale: B01 is an aggregate fair_value coverage flag: 1089 of 1182 leaf rows have fair_value, below the 0.95 threshold. The source schedule total is internally anchored: Total Investments fair value is 1,796,706,145 in the SOI and ties to the balance sheet total investments, so the issue is not a schedule-total disagreement. The source contains bona fide investment rows whose fair value cell is a dash, meaning disclosed zero fair value, including American Physician Partners, LLC Term Loan at table 10 row 27 and GHP-EIP Aggregator, LLC Common Units at table 25 row 6. Counting those disclosed zero fair values as missing is an extraction/normalization gap, so the flag is a real data error.
